booking_error.title: The booking could not be completed
booking_error.generic: The booking could not be completed.
booking_error.QUOTE_EXPIRED: The flight quote expired. Search flights again to get a current price.

booking_error.QUOTE_GENERATION_FAILED: The airline did not return a quote for this flight.

booking_error.AWB_MISSING: This booking has no AWB, so it cannot be cancelled with the airline.

booking_error.CANCEL_TIMEOUT: The airline did not answer in time. The cancellation MAY have gone through: check it before retrying.
booking_error.SIMULATED_RESPONSE: The booking ran in simulation mode and nothing was created at the airline.
booking_error.ENV_MISMATCH: The environment configuration prevents sending this booking to the airline.
booking_error.MISSING_WEIGHT: The shipment has no weight, and it cannot be quoted without one.
booking_error.NETWORK_ERROR: The server could not be reached. Check the connection and try again.
